pages.observation: This page has captions and labels only, no balloons. Reading order: (1) top-left caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' (Ravi on a train, thinking, holding his phone); (2) top-right label 'WELBUK VISION' (an older, previously unseen doctor in front of a clinic building, with linked clinic icons in the sky); (3) caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.'; (4) middle panel, second label 'WELBUK VISION', then caption 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' (Ravi with a woman in a yellow kurta and a boy looking at a tablet); (5) bottom panel, top-right label 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health' (the receptionist, the doctor and Ravi in front of the clinic); (6) bottom-left caption 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.' Issues: (a) The time and place jump is unclear. Page 06 ends with Ravi leaving the clinic, and now he is on a train under 'Tomorrow'. It is not clear whether this is literally the next day, a future trip, or imagined. 'us' and 'our hometown' have no clear speaker, since there is no balloon, the caption is not marked as Ravi's thought, and no narrator has been set up. (b) The older doctor in panel 2 and the woman and boy in panel 3 are never introduced. A first reader cannot tell whether the woman and boy are Ravi's family or whether the older man is a specialist. (c) The 'WELBUK VISION' label appears twice in a row (panels 2 and 3), which is repetitive. Neither label sits on a specific screen or object. (d) In panel 4 the top-right label box butts against the right side of Ravi's head and covers part of his raised arm and shoulder, crowding his face. (e) The bottom-left caption's right edge touches the doctor's lower legs. That is minor, but the box sits on the figures' feet area. (f) Panel 2: the caption box starts just under the older doctor's gesturing hand and covers his torso and part of the building; the hand stays visible. (g) Continuity: in panel 4 the receptionist holds a phone at her side and Ravi carries his bag on his shoulder, which is consistent with page 06. Panel 4 shows Ravi back at the clinic after the train, which adds to the confusion about time.
